verdict.rationale: Jan is fundamentally a chat-based interface for local/cloud LLMs where natural-language is the primary interaction mode, and it adds MCP integration explicitly for 'agentic capabilities' plus custom assistants for task-specific NL workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of NL-driven agentic actions beyond chat, and richer documentation of what MCP-enabled agentic commands can actually do.
